AbsolutePathBuf.description:
A path that is guaranteed to be absolute and normalized (though it is not guaranteed to be canonicalized or exist on the filesystem).

IMPORTANT: When deserializing an `AbsolutePathBuf`, a base path must be set using [AbsolutePathBufGuard::new]. If no base path is set, the deserialization will fail unless the path being deserialized is already absolute.

config_file.description: Path to a role-specific config layer. Relative paths are resolved relative to the `config.toml` that defines them.

description.description: Human-facing role documentation used in spawn tool guidance. Required unless supplied by the referenced agent role file.

nickname_candidates.description: Candidate nicknames for agents spawned with this role.

default_subagent_model.description: Default model for spawned subagents when the spawn call does not select one.

default_subagent_reasoning_effort.description: Default reasoning effort for spawned subagents when the spawn call does not select one.

enabled.description: Whether multi-agent tools are enabled. Defaults to true. An enabled `features.multi_agent_v2` setting takes precedence.

interrupt_message.description: Whether to record a model-visible message when an agent turn is interrupted. Defaults to true.

max_concurrent_threads_per_session.description: Maximum number of spawned agent threads that can be open concurrently per session. When unset, the selected multi-agent backend uses its default.

max_depth.description: Maximum nesting depth for V1 agent threads. Ignored by V2.

AnalyticsConfigToml.description: Analytics settings loaded from config.toml. Fields are optional so we can apply defaults.

enabled.description: When `false`, disables OpenAI analytics across Codex product surfaces in this profile. Custom OTLP metrics exporters remain enabled; set `otel.metrics_exporter = "none"` to disable them.

AuthCredentialsStoreMode.description: Determine where Codex should store CLI auth credentials.

oneOf.description: Persist credentials in CODEX_HOME/auth.json.
Persist credentials in the keyring. Fail if unavailable.
Use keyring when available; otherwise, fall back to a file in CODEX_HOME.
Store credentials in memory only for the current process.

AutoCompactTokenLimitScope.description: Selects which part of the active context is charged against `model_auto_compact_token_limit`.

oneOf.description: Count the full active context against the limit.
Count sampled output and later growth after the carried window prefix.

AwsAuthRefreshConfig.description: Command used to refresh AWS credentials for a model provider.

args.description: Arguments passed to the refresh command.

command.description: Executable to invoke directly, without a shell.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for the refresh command to complete.

AwsCredentialExportConfig.description: Command used to export AWS signing credentials for a model provider.

args.description: Arguments passed to the credential export command.

command.description: Executable to invoke directly, without a shell.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for the credential export command to complete.

ConfigProfile.description: Collection of common configuration options that a user can define as a unit in `config.toml`.

features.description: Optional feature toggles scoped to this profile.

model_catalog_json.description: Optional path to a JSON model catalog (applied on startup only).

model_instructions_file.description: Optional path to a file containing model instructions.

model_provider.description: The key in the `model_providers` map identifying the [`ModelProviderInfo`] to use.

personality.description: Deprecated: `friendly` and `pragmatic` no longer select a style.

service_tier.description: Optional explicit service tier request id for new turns (for example `default`, `priority`, or `flex`; legacy `fast` also works).

CurrentTimeReminderDeliveryMode.description: Which inference boundaries may receive current-time reminders.

oneOf.description: Allow a reminder before any inference request once the interval is due.
Allow reminders after user input or tool output; new context windows still force one.

ForcedChatgptWorkspaceIds.description: Backward-compatible shape for ChatGPT workspace login restrictions in config.toml.

disable_warnings.description: Legacy no-op setting retained for compatibility.

ignore_large_untracked_dirs.description: Legacy no-op setting retained for compatibility.

ignore_large_untracked_files.description: Legacy no-op setting retained for compatibility.

max_goal_token_budget.description: Maximum token budget allowed for a goal and default budget for new goals.

additionalContextLimit.description: Approximate token threshold for spilling this hook's `additionalContext` to disk. Unset uses 2,500 tokens; `0` disables spilling for this hook. The threshold is evaluated against the original context; a spilled preview also includes recovery metadata.

idp.description: Shared enterprise authorization, independent of Codex account credentials.

McpServerAuth.description: Authentication flow for an HTTP MCP server. Explicit credentials take precedence for OAuth and ChatGPT; EMA rejects alternate credentials and fallback.

oneOf.description: Use stored MCP OAuth credentials when available. Starting an OAuth login is a separate operation.
Use the current ChatGPT session for servers on the trusted first-party ChatGPT origin. If no ChatGPT session provider is available, startup can still fall back to stored OAuth credentials.
Exchange an enterprise IdP refresh token for resource-specific authorization. Alternate credentials and ordinary OAuth fallback are not permitted.

client_id.description: Public OAuth client registered with that enterprise IdP.

issuer.description: Issuer used for enterprise OAuth discovery and identity validation.

McpServerOAuthConfig.description: Client settings for MCP OAuth login or enterprise token exchange.

authorization_server_issuer.description: Expected resource authorization server issuer for EMA token exchange.

callback_port.description: Fixed callback port that takes precedence over Codex's global OAuth callback port.

callback_url.description: Registered callback URL associated with this OAuth client.

client_id.description: Explicit OAuth client identifier to present during authorization and token exchange.

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret used for token exchange with a pre-registered client.

McpServerToolConfig.description: Per-tool settings for a single MCP server tool.

output_token_limit.description: Token budget for this tool's output, before the standard 20% serialization allowance.

McpStartupReadiness.description: Readiness needed before startup can expose this server's tools to the model.

oneOf.description: Use the live connection to determine startup readiness.
Allow a valid cached tool catalog while the live connection starts. Tool execution still requires the current connection.

ModelProviderAuthInfo.description: Configuration for obtaining a provider bearer token from a command.

command.description: Command to execute. Bare names are resolved via `PATH`; paths are resolved against `cwd`.

cwd.description: Working directory used when running the token command.

refresh_interval_ms.description: Maximum age for the cached token before rerunning the command. Set to `0` to disable proactive refresh and only rerun after a 401 retry path.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for the token command to exit successfully.

ModelProviderAwsAuthInfo.description: AWS SigV4 auth configuration for a model provider.

auth_refresh.description: Optional command used to reauthenticate after a refreshable AWS auth failure.

credential_export.description: Optional command whose exported credentials replace the AWS SDK credential chain.

profile.description: AWS profile name to use. When unset, the AWS SDK default chain decides.

region.description: AWS region to use for provider-specific endpoints.

ModelProviderCapabilities.description: Overrides for the optional API features supported by a custom provider.

external_web_access.description: Whether hosted web search may access the live web.

remote_compaction.description: Remote context-compaction protocol; omission preserves provider defaults.

ModelProviderInfo.description: Serializable representation of a provider definition.

auth.description: Command-backed bearer-token configuration for this provider.

aws.description: AWS SigV4 auth configuration for this provider.

base_url.description: Base URL for the provider's OpenAI-compatible API.

capabilities.description: Optional API capability overrides for a custom Responses-compatible provider. Unspecified capabilities retain their existing provider defaults.

env_http_headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to include in requests to this provider where the (key, value) pairs are the header name and _environment variable_ whose value should be used. If the environment variable is not set, or the value is empty, the header will not be included in the request.

env_key.description: Environment variable that stores the user's API key for this provider.

env_key_instructions.description: Optional instructions to help the user get a valid value for the variable and set it.

experimental_bearer_token.description: Value to use with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Use of this config is discouraged in favor of `env_key` for security reasons, but this may be necessary when using this programmatically.

gateway_oauth.description: Secondary OAuth credentials required by the provider's gateway.

http_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to include in requests to this provider where the (key, value) pairs are the header name and value.

model_catalog_url.description: Optional full URL for a Codex-native model catalog. When unset, OpenAI discovery uses the Codex backend unless `base_url` overrides the inference endpoint.

query_params.description: Optional query parameters to append to the base URL.

request_max_retries.description: Maximum number of times to retry a failed HTTP request to this provider.

requires_openai_auth.description: Does this provider require an OpenAI API key or ChatGPT login token? If true, the user is presented with a login screen on first run, and credentials are stored using the backend selected by `cli_auth_credentials_store`. If false (the default), the login screen is skipped, and the API key (if needed) comes from the environment variable specified by `env_key`.

stream_idle_timeout_ms.description: Idle timeout (in milliseconds) to wait for activity on a streaming response before treating the connection as lost.

stream_max_retries.description: Number of times to retry reconnecting a dropped streaming response before failing.

supports_standalone_web_search.description: Whether this provider supports the standalone web-search endpoint.

supports_websockets.description: Whether this provider supports the Responses API WebSocket transport.

websocket_connect_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for a websocket connection attempt before treating it as failed.

wire_api.description: Which wire protocol this provider expects.

disable_direct_message.description: Disable the model's direct-message tools; spawning and automatic child results remain available.

expose_spawn_agent_model_overrides.description: Exposes `model` and `reasoning_effort` on the multi-agent v2 spawn tool and adds corresponding guidance to root and subagent usage hints.

message_board_remote.description: Use a session-scoped remote board instead of the in-memory board.

preserve_fork_prefix.description: Preserve the parent's model-visible history on full forks and append child instructions. Defaults to false. Legacy compaction without a reusable context baseline still rebuilds.

subagent_developer_instructions.description: Overrides inherited developer instructions for subagents without role-specific instructions.

usage_hint_enabled.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Its value is ignored.

server_names.description: MCP servers whose tools should omit the legacy `mcp__` namespace prefix.

OAuthCredentialsStoreMode.description: Determine where Codex should store and read MCP credentials.

oneOf.description: Prefer `Keyring` and use `File` when keyring storage is unavailable. Once an MCP client loads credentials from one store, that client keeps the resolved store for its lifetime so refreshes cannot switch to a possibly stale credential source. Credentials stored in the keyring will only be readable by Codex unless the user explicitly grants access via OS-level keyring access.
CODEX_HOME/.credentials.json This file will be readable to Codex and other applications running as the same user.
Keyring when available, otherwise fail.

OtelConfigToml.description: OTEL settings loaded from config.toml. Fields are optional so we can apply defaults.

environment.description: Mark traces with environment (dev, staging, prod, test). Defaults to dev.

log_agent_responses.description: Opt in to logging final main-agent and spawned-subagent responses to an OTLP log exporter. Defaults to false. Response text can be sensitive and is capped at 64 KiB.

metrics_exporter.description: Metrics exporter. Defaults to `statsig`, which follows `analytics.enabled`. Custom OTLP exporters are independent of `analytics.enabled`; `none` disables metrics export.

span_attributes.description: Attributes to add to every exported trace span.

tool_result.description: Byte limit for tool-result log output; independent of model-visible output.

tracestate.description: Semicolon-separated `key:value` fields to upsert into W3C tracestate members.

oneOf.description: Binary payload
JSON payload

Personality.description: Deprecated: `friendly` and `pragmatic` no longer select a style.

RawMcpServerConfig.description:
Raw MCP config shape used for deserialization and supported-field JSON Schema generation.

Fields that are accepted only to produce targeted validation errors should be skipped in the generated schema.

Keep `TryFrom<RawMcpServerConfig> for McpServerConfig` exhaustively destructuring this struct so new TOML fields cannot be added here without updating the validation/mapping logic that produces [`McpServerConfig`].

name.description: Legacy display-name field accepted for backward compatibility.

startup_readiness.description: Whether startup requires a live connection or can use a valid cached tool catalog.

tool_input_schema_max_bytes.description: UTF-8 byte threshold for compacting each ordinary MCP tool input schema. Defaults to 5,000 bytes. Code Mode also uses an explicitly configured limit when rendering each tool's input type. Larger limits preserve more parameter descriptions.

ReasoningEffort.description: A non-empty reasoning effort value advertised by the model.

ReasoningSummary.description: A summary of the reasoning performed by the model. This can be useful for debugging and understanding the model's reasoning process. See https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/reasoning?api-mode=responses#reasoning-summaries

oneOf.description: Option to disable reasoning summaries.

RemoteCompactionSupport.description: Remote context-compaction protocols supported by a model provider.

oneOf.description: Use local compaction instead of a provider compaction protocol.
Send `compaction_trigger` items over the Responses endpoint.

RemoteMessageBoardConfigToml.description: Connection to a board provisioned by the research host.

bearer_token.description: Board credential supplied directly by a runtime config override.

bearer_token_env_var.description: Read the credential from this environment variable instead of bearer_token.

reminder_at_remaining_tokens.description: Remaining weighted-token values that trigger reminders when crossed.

ShellEnvironmentPolicyFilter.description: Assigns a shell environment variable pattern to the include-only or exclude set. Includes do not re-add variables removed by another exclude pattern.

oneOf.description: "Core" environment variables for the platform. On UNIX, this would include HOME, LOGNAME, PATH, SHELL, and USER, among others.
Inherits the full environment from the parent process.
Do not inherit any environment variables from the parent process.

ShellEnvironmentPolicyToml.description: Policy for building the `env` when spawning a process via shell-like tools.

exclude.description: Legacy list of regular expressions to exclude.

filters.description:
Pattern actions used by the canonical table representation.

Ordinary config keeps accepting the legacy arrays above during the migration. Requirements will accept only this keyed form, keeping array compatibility isolated so the legacy fields can be deprecated later. Pattern keys merge case-insensitively across config layers, matching how the resulting patterns match environment variable names.

include_only.description: Legacy list of regular expressions to include.

include_instructions.description: Whether turns receive the automatic skills instructions block.

max_context_tokens.description: Maximum tokens used by the available-skills catalog. Defaults to 2% of the model context window and is capped at 10,000 tokens when set.

SleepToolMode.description: How the sleep tool is selected when its feature gate is enabled.

oneOf.description: Preserve the existing model and legacy clock configuration defaults.
Register sleep regardless of the model or legacy clock configuration.

auto_compact_fallback_buffer_tokens.description: Additional tokens available after the compaction threshold for fallback note-taking.

auto_compact_fallback_prompt.description: Developer message sampled before an automatic context-window rollover.

guidance_message.description: Guidance appended to the context-window metadata in a developer message.

reminder_message_template.description: Reminder template. `{n_remaining}` is replaced with the tokens remaining before auto-compaction.

reminder_threshold_tokens.description: Number of tokens remaining before auto-compaction when the wrap-up reminder is emitted.

use_history_notes_extension.description: Whether to expose the built-in history and notes extension.

ToolExposureSurface.description: A model-facing surface on which a tool can be exposed.

oneOf.description: Tools discovered later through tool search.
Tools present in the model's initial tool list.

error_on_tool_collisions.description: Fail the turn when multiple tools share the same effective name.

turn_metadata_includes_tool_info.description: Include authoritative tool information in per-turn request metadata.

ToolResultLogConfig.description: Limit for the text included in `codex.tool_result` log records. This does not affect model-visible output. Raising it can expose more tool data to logs.

max_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes before the truncation notice. Defaults to 2048.

Verbosity.description: Controls output length/detail on GPT-5 models via the Responses API. Serialized with lowercase values to match the OpenAI API.

WireApi.description: Wire protocol that the provider speaks.

oneOf.description: The Responses API exposed by OpenAI at `/v1/responses`.

allow_login_shell.description:
Whether the model may request a login shell for shell-based tools. Default to `true`

If `true`, the model may request a login shell (`login = true`), and omitting `login` defaults to using a login shell. If `false`, the model can never use a login shell: `login = true` requests are rejected, and omitting `login` defaults to a non-login shell.

analytics.description: When `enabled` is `false`, disables OpenAI analytics across Codex product surfaces on this machine. Custom OTLP metrics exporters are controlled by `otel.metrics_exporter`. When unset, the default depends on the client.

background_terminal_max_timeout.description: Maximum poll window for background terminal output (`write_stdin`), in milliseconds. Default: `300000` (5 minutes).

chatgpt_base_url.description: Base URL for requests to ChatGPT (as opposed to the OpenAI API).

cli_auth_credentials_store.description: Preferred backend for storing CLI auth credentials. file (default): Use a file in the Codex home directory. keyring: Use an OS-specific keyring service. auto: Use the keyring if available, otherwise use a file.

compact_prompt.description: Compact prompt used for history compaction.

developer_instructions.description: Developer instructions inserted as a `developer` role message.

features.description: Centralized feature flags (new). Prefer this over individual toggles.

forced_chatgpt_workspace_id.description: When set, restricts ChatGPT login to one or more workspace identifiers.

forced_login_method.description: When set, restricts the login mechanism users may use.

ghost_snapshot.description: Compatibility-only settings retained so legacy `ghost_snapshot` config still loads.

hide_agent_reasoning.description: When set to `true`, `AgentReasoning` events will be hidden from the UI/output. Defaults to `false`.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks configured inline in TOML plus user-level overrides.

include_collaboration_mode_instructions.description: Whether to inject the `<collaboration_mode>` developer block.

include_environment_context.description: Whether to inject the `<environment_context>` user block.

include_environment_context_time.description: Whether environment context includes the current date and timezone.

log_dir.description: Directory where Codex writes log files. Setting this value explicitly also enables the TUI text log in this directory. Defaults to `$CODEX_HOME/log`.

mcp_enterprise_managed_auth.description: Trusted enterprise IdP shared by EMA-enabled MCP servers and plugins.

mcp_oauth_callback_port.description: Optional fixed port for the local HTTP callback server used during MCP OAuth login. When unset, Codex will bind to an ephemeral port chosen by the OS.

mcp_oauth_callback_url.description: Optional redirect URI to use during MCP OAuth login. When set, this URI is used in the OAuth authorization request instead of the local listener address. The local callback listener still binds to 127.0.0.1 (using `mcp_oauth_callback_port` when provided).

mcp_oauth_credentials_store.description: Preferred backend for storing MCP OAuth credentials. keyring: Use an OS-specific keyring service. https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/rmcp-client/src/oauth.rs#L2 file: Use a file in the Codex home directory. auto (default): Use the OS-specific keyring service if available, otherwise use a file.

mcp_optional_startup_grace_ms.description:
Milliseconds to wait for optional MCP servers while building the initial tool catalog.

Defaults to 1000. Set to 0 to disable the shared grace and wait for each server's configured `startup_timeout_sec` instead.

mcp_servers.description: Definition for MCP servers that Codex can reach out to for tool calls.

model_auto_compact_token_limit.description: Token usage threshold triggering auto-compaction of conversation history.

model_auto_compact_token_limit_scope.description: Controls whether the auto-compaction limit applies to the full context or only to tokens after the carried prefix in the current compaction window.

model_catalog_json.description: Optional path to a JSON model catalog (applied on startup only). Per-thread `config` overrides are accepted but do not reapply this (no-ops).

model_context_window.description: Size of the context window for the model, in tokens.

model_instructions_file.description: Optional path to a file containing model instructions that will override the built-in instructions for the selected model. Users are STRONGLY DISCOURAGED from using this field, as deviating from the instructions sanctioned by Codex will likely degrade model performance.

model_post_turn_compact_threshold_percen.description: Percentage of the usable context window that triggers compaction after a final response. Existing auto-compaction limits still apply. Omitted or zero disables turn-end compaction; valid values are 0–100.

model_provider.description: Provider to use from the model_providers map.

model_providers.description: User-defined provider entries that extend the built-in list. Built-in IDs cannot be overridden.

model_verbosity.description: Optional verbosity control for GPT-5 models (Responses API `text.verbosity`).

notify.description: Optional external command to spawn for end-user notifications.

openai_base_url.description: Base URL override for the built-in `openai` model provider.

oss_provider.description: Preferred OSS provider for local models, e.g. "lmstudio" or "ollama".

personality.description: Deprecated: `friendly` and `pragmatic` no longer select a style.

profile.description: Profile to use from the `profiles` map.

profiles.description: Named profiles to facilitate switching between different configurations.

project_doc_fallback_filenames.description: Ordered list of fallback filenames to look for when AGENTS.md is missing.

project_doc_max_bytes.description: Maximum total bytes of project instruction content across all selected environments.

project_root_markers.description: Markers used to detect the project root when searching parent directories for `.codex` folders. Defaults to [".git"] when unset.

responses_api_metadata.description: Bounded, product-owned metadata attached to every Responses API request.

review_model.description: Review model override used by the `/review` feature.

service_tier.description: Optional explicit service tier request id for new turns (for example `default`, `priority`, or `flex`; legacy `fast` also works).

show_raw_agent_reasoning.description: When set to `true`, `AgentReasoningRawContentEvent` events will be shown in the UI/output. Defaults to `false`.

skills.description: User-level skill config entries keyed by SKILL.md path.

suppress_unstable_features_warning.description: Suppress warnings about unstable (under development) features.

thread_unload_delay_secs.description: Seconds a thread must have no subscribers and no activity before app-server unloads it. Defaults to 1800 (30 minutes); zero unloads immediately. Changes require a server restart.

tool_output_token_limit.description: Token budget applied when storing tool/function outputs in the context manager.

tools.description: Nested tools section for feature toggles

web_search.description: Controls the web search tool mode: disabled, cached, indexed, or live.
